title: Just One Variant
goal: Extract payload from a single enum variant using if let.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 2 Morning: Pattern Matching

hints: Use the `if let` construct when matching a refutable pattern on a single variant.
Block braces `{}` are mandatory for both `if` and `else` branches in Rust.
explanation: `if let Config::Port(p) = cfg` tests if `cfg` matches `Config::Port` and binds `p` inside the block. A plain `let` pattern must be irrefutable (matching all possible values of the type), so writing `let Config::Port(p) = cfg` triggers `E0005`. Rust requires block braces `{}` after `else`, so `else 8080` fails to parse. Both branches must produce the same return type (`u16`), making string `"8080"` fail with `E0308`.
